mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `org` (name, active_name_key, slug, description, background, owner_id, status, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{name}, #{activeNameKey}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{background}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `org` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT o.* FROM `org` o INNER JOIN org_member m ON o.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.gmt_create DESC

SELECT o.id, o.name, o.description, o.owner_id, r.access_level, m.joined_at FROM `org` o INNER JOIN org_member m ON o.id = m.tenant_id INNER JOIN workspace_role r ON r.id = m.role_id AND r.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.gmt_create DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `org` WHERE owner_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE `org` SET owner_id = #{newOwnerId}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{oldOwnerId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE `org` SET name = #{name}, active_name_key = #{activeNameKey}, description = #{description}, background = #{background}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE `org` SET is_deleted = 1, active_name_key = NULL, deleted_at = NOW(3), deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, modifier_id = #{deletedBy}, version = version + 1, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE `org` SET is_deleted = 0, name = #{name}, active_name_key = #{activeNameKey}, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `org` WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
